ABOUT INNHANCE

Built for the hotel that runs on
relationships, not spreadsheets.

India's boutique hotels are built on warmth and personal touch, yet most still lose bookings to midnight WhatsApp messages that go unanswered. Innhance changes that.

TRUSTED BY BOUTIQUE HOTELS ACROSS INDIA

24/7
Booking automation, even while you sleep
0+

₹0
Lost to unanswered inquiries, ever again

The problem we solve

A heritage haveli in Rajasthan shouldn't need a full-time reservations desk. We give boutique properties enterprise-grade booking intelligence delivered through the app your guests already use.

Our approach

We don't replace the host. We free them. Innhance handles the back-and-forth so hoteliers can focus on the moments that matter, the welcome, the story, the experience.
